+#!/usr/bin/env python
+"""Test script to reproduce the dbshell issue with PostgreSQL."""
+
+from django.db.backends.postgresql.client import DatabaseClient
+
+# Test case from the issue
+settings_dict = {
+    "NAME": "some_database",
+    "USER": "someuser",
+    "PASSWORD": "somepassword",
+    "HOST": "somehost",
+    "PORT": "5432",
+}
+
+parameters = ["-c", "select * from some_table;"]
+
+args, env = DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env(settings_dict, parameters)
+
+print("Current implementation:")
+print("Args:", args)
+print()
+
+# According to the issue, psql expects options to come before the database name
+# So the correct order should be:
+# ["psql", "-U", "someuser", "-h", "somehost", "-p", "5432", "-c", "select * from some_table;", "some_database"]
+# But currently it's:
+# ["psql", "-U", "someuser", "-h", "somehost", "-p", "5432", "some_database", "-c", "select * from some_table;"]
+
+print("Expected order (options before database name):")
+print("['psql', '-U', 'someuser', '-h', 'somehost', '-p', '5432', '-c', 'select * from some_table;', 'some_database']")
+print()
+
+print("Current order (database name before options):")
+print(args)

+#!/usr/bin/env python
+"""Test script to verify the dbshell fix."""
+
+import os
+import sys
+import django
+from django.conf import settings
+
+# Configure Django settings
+if not settings.configured:
+    settings.configure(
+        DEBUG=True,
+        DATABASES={
+            'default': {
+                'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3',
+                'NAME': ':memory:',
+            }
+        },
+        INSTALLED_APPS=[
+            'django.contrib.contenttypes',
+            'django.contrib.auth',
+        ],
+    )
+    django.setup()
+
+# Now run the tests
+from django.test.utils import get_runner
+from django.test import TestCase
+from tests.dbshell.test_postgresql import PostgreSqlDbshellCommandTestCase
+from tests.dbshell.test_mysql import MySqlDbshellCommandTestCase
+
+# Create test instances
+pg_test = PostgreSqlDbshellCommandTestCase()
+mysql_test = MySqlDbshellCommandTestCase()
+
+# Run the parameter tests
+print("Testing PostgreSQL parameters...")
+try:
+    pg_test.test_parameters()
+    print("✓ PostgreSQL test_parameters passed")
+except AssertionError as e:
+    print(f"✗ PostgreSQL test_parameters failed: {e}")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+print("\nTesting MySQL parameters...")
+try:
+    mysql_test.test_parameters()
+    print("✓ MySQL test_parameters passed")
+except AssertionError as e:
+    print(f"✗ MySQL test_parameters failed: {e}")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+# Test other PostgreSQL tests to ensure we didn't break anything
+print("\nTesting PostgreSQL basic...")
+try:
+    pg_test.test_basic()
+    print("✓ PostgreSQL test_basic passed")
+except AssertionError as e:
+    print(f"✗ PostgreSQL test_basic failed: {e}")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+print("\nTesting PostgreSQL nopass...")
+try:
+    pg_test.test_nopass()
+    print("✓ PostgreSQL test_nopass passed")
+except AssertionError as e:
+    print(f"✗ PostgreSQL test_nopass failed: {e}")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+print("\nTesting MySQL basic_params_specified_in_settings...")
+try:
+    mysql_test.test_basic_params_specified_in_settings()
+    print("✓ MySQL test_basic_params_specified_in_settings passed")
+except AssertionError as e:
+    print(f"✗ MySQL test_basic_params_specified_in_settings failed: {e}")
+    sys.exit(1)
+
+print("\n✓ All tests passed!")
